title: Isandro and the Oath
author: Ada Halloran
blurb: Odile Sandoval, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
